research.eps_rev_basis: Next fiscal year (FY2027) normalized consensus EPS, Yahoo Finance EPS Trend: $13.20 90 days ago -> $15.33 60 and 30 days ago -> $15.72 now (+19.1%). research.last_earnings_summary: Q2 FY2026 (reported 4 Aug 2026): revenue $11.54B (+50% YoY) vs about $11.3B expected, non-GAAP EPS $1.66 vs $1.62 expected; data center revenue $6.7B, more than double YoY and 58% of sales. Q3 guide of about $13B +/- $0.3B (about +41% YoY, non-GAAP gross margin about 56%) was reported as above consensus, yet the stock fell nearly 9% after hours as investors wanted a stronger AI outlook and the margin line disappointed.
research.margin_basis: Latest quarter (Q2 FY2026, ended 27 Jun 2026) vs the same quarter a year earlier (Q2 FY2025, ended 28 Jun 2025), as shown by StockAnalysis. Its gross margin excludes amortization of acquired intangibles, so it sits near the company's non-GAAP figure; the company's own release gives GAAP gross margin 54% vs 40% and non-GAAP 56% vs 43%, GAAP operating margin 17% vs -2% and non-GAAP 27% vs 12%. The year-ago quarter was depressed by a one-off charge, so the YoY margin jump overstates the underlying improvement. TTM: gross 55.72%, operating 15.82%.
research.customer_concentration: No customer accounted for 10% or more of consolidated net revenue in fiscal 2025 or fiscal 2024 (FY2025 10-K); one Client and Gaming customer was 18% in fiscal 2023. Not captured in that disclosure: data center is now 58% of revenue and the MI450 / Helios ramp leans on a few very large buyers (OpenAI, Oracle, Meta), so concentration is likely to rise in FY2026-27.

Total about $105M, negligible against a roughly $1.06T market value. Buyback: $221M repurchased in the first half of 2026; no new authorization found. No equity offering, ATM, convertible or lock-up found. Next earnings 3 Nov 2026 after the close.
research.one_line_story: AMD beat and guided Q3 above consensus on 4 Aug but sold off (about -9% after hours) on a high bar and a soft margin line and drifted to the mid-September low; it then ran to record highs above a $1T market value as FY2027 EPS estimates rose about 19% (to $15.72, implying EPS roughly doubling again), the MI450 / Helios rack ramp with OpenAI, Oracle and Meta came into view, Lisa Su said supply will rise substantially in 2027, and brokers lifted targets (Citi to $800 from $575 on 6 Oct) in a sector-wide chip rally.
research.gaps: Differences from our comps table: (1) Forward P/E: StockAnalysis shows 56.89 vs our 82.9. Ours matches price divided by FY2026 EPS (631.75 / 7.59 = about 83); theirs appears to use a later twelve-month window. Not a data conflict, a basis difference. (2) EV/sales: public 25.46 vs our 21.7. The price gap (649.54 on 6 Oct vs 631.75 on 5 Oct) explains only about 3 points of that; our figure looks low even on our own market value ($1030B / $41.3B = about 25). (3) Gross margin: public TTM 55.72% vs our 53.2% (GAAP vs ex-amortization basis). Revenue growth TTM, operating margin, FCF margin and next-FY growth agree closely. Other limits: prices are 6 Oct (one day after the study's 5 Oct close). Market cap and EV are rounded on the page ($1.06T / $1.05T). Net cash $8.84B and debt are the 27 Jun 2026 balance sheet, before the $4.75B notes of 17 Aug; gross debt is now higher, and whether any proceeds repaid debt is not known. FY2027 EPS growth of 107.1% is my calculation from Yahoo ($15.72 / $7.59), StockAnalysis did not show FY2027. This-FY EPS growth 81.7% is on a non-GAAP basis ($7.58 vs $4.17). Revenue estimate revision: no then-and-now pair found; "up" rests on the Q3 guide landing above consensus and the 19% rise in FY2027 EPS. Guidance "raised": AMD gives only next-quarter guidance, so this means the Q3 guide ($13B) was above prior consensus and above the Q2 guide, not a formal full-year raise. The post-earnings reaction is the after-hours move (nearly -9%); the next-day closing move was not confirmed. Lisa Su's 95,000-share sale is dated 10 Sep by MarketBeat and 4 Sep by one news item. Remaining buyback authorization not found; buyback is small ($221M in H1 2026) and the share count is still rising about 1% a year. I did not verify whether share warrants tied to the OpenAI supply deal vest in the window; if they do, that would be extra dilution not reflected in supply_overhang. Customer concentration is from the FY2025 10-K only; no 2026 10-Q concentration text was checked. Some web search summaries mixed in 2025 articles; only items dated 2026 were used.
